summary: Backend-only verification of hardened /api/kiosk/tenants/{id}/payments endpoint. Executed 13 pytest tests covering kiosk-pin login, valid tenants (200 + no company_logo_bytes leakage), unknown tenant (404 not 500), unauthenticated (401), regression on overview/notes/receipts. All 13/13 passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py exceeds 10000 lines - strongly recommend splitting into modules (kiosk, admin, payments, tenants). Line 10443 endpoint should live in a dedicated kiosk router file.
Top-level try/except returning [] on any crash masks real errors; ensure structured logging captures the exception with tenant_id so silent failures can be traced.
Stripping bytes fields ad-hoc in _enrich_payments_bulk is a symptom; consider excluding company_logo_bytes at the projection level in the Mongo query to avoid ever loading binaries into memory.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_kiosk_payments_hardening.py covers the full contract for /api/kiosk/tenants/{id}/payments: 200/404/401 paths and no bytes leakage. Reuse as regression when touching kiosk endpoints.
rca of the issue: Original 500 was reported for tenant 2d286e69-... which no longer exists after DB wipe on 2026-02-08. Fixes verified: (a) unknown tenant now returns 404 (not 500), (b) valid tenants return 200 with clean JSON, (c) company_logo_bytes never appears in payment payloads, (d) unauth requests return 401. No 500s observed in any tested path.
